# Execute names

<!-- Generated by `delphi docs execute-names` from agents/*/AGENT.md and the list beside the host capability map (crates/delphi-engine/src/mcp_packs.rs). Do not edit by hand: change the manifest or the list and regenerate. -->

Every name a built-in role lists in `default_access_scope.execute`, and what grants it (`specs/124` §3). A name is a label, not a permission: listing one gives a role nothing unless the daemon reads it.

- **daemon**: Delphi's daemon offers the tool or context named in the next column. Where the column says the daemon reads the name, removing the name from a manifest removes the tool; where it says the tool is offered by role id or to every role, the name only labels it.
- **host-only**: nothing in the daemon reads the name. It tells a host which of its own capabilities (`specs/098` §4) the role expects there; the host's permissions decide whether the role gets them.
- **nothing**: no code grants it. `delphi lint` fails a manifest that lists such a name.

The last column is the host capability a role's pack lists because of the name: advice to the host, never a grant.

| name | roles | granted by | what it stands for | host capability |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `agent-dispatch` | `orchestrator` | daemon | `dispatch_agent` (and `search_agent_registry` when the registry routes); the daemon reads this name | `delegate` |
| `ast-search` | `investigator` | host-only | no daemon tool; inside Delphi the role searches with `search` | `search_code` |
| `benchmark-runner` | `investigator` | host-only | no daemon tool of its own; inside Delphi a benchmark runs through `shell-worktree-scoped` | `shell` |
| `cli-harness-delegate` | `builder` | host-only | no daemon tool the role calls | `delegate` |
| `daemon-fetch` | `validator` | host-only | no tool the role calls by this name; inside Delphi the daemon's own pipelines fetch | `fetch` |
| `dependency-auditor` | `scout` | host-only | no daemon tool; inside Delphi the role reads manifests with `read_file` and `search` | `search_code` |
| `git-bisect-readonly` | `investigator` | host-only | no daemon tool of its own; inside Delphi a bisect runs through `shell-worktree-scoped` | `shell` |
| `git-worktree` | `builder`, `investigator` | host-only | no tool the role calls; the daemon attaches the worktree itself | `shell` |
| `inspect-system` | `administrator`, `orchestrator` | daemon | `inspect_system`; the daemon offers it by role id (administrator, orchestrator), not by this name | none |
| `kb-search` | `validator` | daemon | `kb_search`; the daemon offers it to every role, not by this name | none |
| `org-context` | `administrator`, `advocate`, `architect`, `assistant`, `orchestrator`, `red-team`, `strategist` | daemon | the org-context slice and `check_alignment`, when a bundle is active; the daemon reads this name | none |
| `propose-admin-action` | `administrator` | daemon | `propose_admin_action`; the daemon offers it by role id (administrator), not by this name | none |
| `repo-mapper` | `scout` | host-only | no daemon tool; inside Delphi the role maps with `list_dir`, `read_file` and `search` | `search_code` |
| `scoped-web-verify` | `investigator` | daemon | `verify_source`; the daemon reads this name | `search_web`, `fetch` |
| `settings` | `orchestrator` | daemon | `change_setting`; the daemon reads this name | none |
| `shell-worktree-scoped` | `builder`, `investigator` | daemon | `run_command` and `shell`: in the task's worktree with a write scope there, else in an investigation's throwaway copy; the daemon reads this name | `shell` |
| `test-runner` | `builder` | host-only | no daemon tool of its own; inside Delphi tests run through `shell-worktree-scoped` | `shell` |
| `timers` | `orchestrator` | daemon | `timer`; the daemon reads this name | none |
| `web-search` | `scout`, `validator` | host-only | no tool the role calls by this name; inside Delphi the daemon's research pipeline searches | `search_web` |
